tasks.label: Run API tests after removing Try
TestAuth: start postgres container
args:
docker rm -f ligitabl-testapi-db >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

docker run -d --name ligitabl-testapi-db -e POSTGRES_DB=ligitabl -e POSTGRES_USER=ligitabl -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=ligitabl -p 15432:5432 postgres:16 >/dev/null

for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec ligitabl-testapi-db pg_isready -U ligitabl -d ligitabl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Postgres is ready.";
    exit 0;
  fi
  sleep 1
done

echo "Postgres did not become ready in time" >&2
exit 1
